responsibility: This file contains the intrinsic resolution routines that assign result types, shapes, argument coercions, and final library entry names to intrinsic calls after matching succeeds. It builds stable mangled names via gfc_get_string, resolves transformational and inquiry result properties, inserts needed kind/logical conversions, and maps both intrinsic functions and intrinsic subroutines onto the libgfortran or frontend helper symbols that later lowering will call.
